curatedMovie.curiosityHook: What unseen influence is driving Earthsea into ruin, and what inner burden haunts the young prince accompanying the archmage?
curatedMovie.description: As failing crops and returning dragons push Earthsea toward chaos, Archmage Sparrowhawk joins Arren, a troubled prince, to uncover the hidden force tearing the realm's balance apart.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: Thoughtful yet exciting anime adventure with steady pacing, mythical atmosphere, and moderate emotional weight.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: Directed by Goro Miyazaki, this animated fantasy balances high-stakes peril with a thoughtful quest to understand a collapsing world.
